import sys
import heapq

def can_finish(n_ops, T, support, wait, recall):
    """
    Simulate with n_ops operators.
    Returns True if all customers can be completed by time T.
    """
    # Min-heap of operator available times
    ops = [0] * n_ops
    heapq.heapify(ops)

    # Min-heap of customers by next call time: (call_time, customer_id)
    callers = [(0, i) for i in range(len(support))]
    heapq.heapify(callers)

    completed = 0
    total = len(support)

    while completed < total:
        if not callers:
            return False

        call_time, i = heapq.heappop(callers)

        # Earliest operator available
        op_time = heapq.heappop(ops)

        # If operator is free before call, service starts at call time
        # otherwise customer waits until op_time
        start = max(call_time, op_time)

        # Customer hangs up if waited too long
        if op_time - call_time > wait[i]:
            # call again after recall interval
            next_call = call_time + recall[i]
            if next_call > T:
                heapq.heappush(ops, op_time)
                return False
            heapq.heappush(callers, (next_call, i))
            heapq.heappush(ops, op_time)
            continue

        finish = start + support[i]
        if finish > T:
            heapq.heappush(ops, finish)
            return False

        heapq.heappush(ops, finish)
        completed += 1

    return True

    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:

    out = []

        n = data[p]
        T = data[p + 1]
        p += 2

        if n == 0 and T == 0:
            break

        support = []
        wait = []
        recall = []

        for _ in range(n):
            s = data[p]
            w = data[p + 1]
            r = data[p + 2]
            p += 3
            support.append(s)
            wait.append(w)
            recall.append(r)

        lo, hi = 1, n
        ans = n
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if can_finish(mid, T, support, wait, recall):
                ans = mid
                hi = mid - 1
            else:
                lo = mid + 1

        out.append(str(ans))

    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out))

    main()
